children.text: When the video appears on a person’s screen, it is immediately presented with text across the top of the video saying, “installing a wig (or trying my hardest to),”establishing the purpose/tone of the video. Rather than posting the video with no context, and leaving the audience to interpret the video as a serious wig tutorial, Vanillamace uses the phrase “or trying my hardest to” to sort of make fun of her own lack of expertise and prepare the audience for an imperfect process. This makes the purpose of the video less about teaching her viewers how to install a wig, and more about entertaining them through her experience as if she was taking everyone along the journey with her. Using pathos, Vanilla incorporates her humour and personality in her content and the way it is presented, which gives viewers a reason to continue watching even if they are not interested in learning about installing a wig.
